records.topic: front wheel, rear hub, axles and chain: shared across all TF models
records.statement: Every TF motocross bike uses the same front wheel (T2009269, 1.6x21) with the same hub, spindle, spacer and bearings, and the same rear hub (T2015093), rear spindle (T2011135), rear spacers, chain adjuster blocks, 48T rear sprocket (T2015061) and 520 x 114-link chain (T2015057). So a front wheel swaps between any TF 250-X and TF 450. Catch on the rear wheel: the TF 250-X rear wheel (T2015094) has a 1.85x19 rim and the TF 450 (T2015046) a 2.15x19 rim; the hub and axle are the same, so it bolts in, but the rim width (and tire size) differs.

records.notes: Catalogues compared: TF 250-X 2024-2025 (catalogue CC7868), TF 250-X 2026 (CF3825), TF 450-RC Edition (2025) and TF 450-X (2026). TF 450-X rear wheel page: https://www.triumphpartstore.com/us/catalog/assembly/23713?catalogue=T.

records.topic: frame, swingarm and footpegs: shared; subframe and shock differ 250 vs 450
records.statement: All TF models list the same main frame (T2078475), the same swingarm (T2051612) and pivot spindle, and the same footpegs (T2083238/T2083239) and clevises. The rear subframe differs: T2074959 on the TF 250-X (all years) and T2075413 on the TF 450-RC Edition and TF 450-X. The shock is model-specific (TF 250-X T2051711, TF 450-RC T2053015, TF 450-X T2054044). Engine head-steady brackets also differ by model. So a 450 subframe is not listed for a 250 and the reverse.

records.topic: forks and triple clamps: 250 and 450 units differ
records.statement: The TF 250-X (2024-2026) uses forks T2043161/T2043162 with lower yoke T2044587 and upper yoke T2044585; the TF 450-RC Edition and TF 450-X use forks T2046481/T2046482 with lower yoke T2046421 and upper yoke T2046411 (different cartridge and base valve). Fork seals, bleed screws and the spring seat are shared, and the 4.8 and 4.9 N/mm spring kits are listed for both. Swap forks as complete sets with their own yokes; a 450 fork in a 250 needs the 450 yokes too, and Triumph lists no such conversion.

records.topic: bodywork and seat: 2026 changed side panels and airbox covers
records.statement: Front mudguard T2313252 fits every TF. The seat (T2310994) is the same on the TF 250-X 2024-2026 and TF 450-X (the RC Edition has its own gripper seat). The 2026 TF 250-X and the TF 450-X share new tank side covers (T2313590/T2313591), airbox covers (T2313663/T2313667) and rear mudguard (T2313790); the 2024-2025 TF 250-X uses older covers (T2310630/T2310631 or T2313890/T2313891) and the RC Edition its own. So 2024-2025 TF 250-X side panels are not the 2026 parts. Triumph's MX plastics kit A9700932 is listed for the TF 250-X 2024-2026 and TF 450.

records.statement: The TF 250-X header pipe (T2205896) is the same 2024-2026, but the silencer changed for 2026 (T2204970 on 2024-2025, T2209937 on 2026) along with the airbox (front and rear) for sound rules. The TF 450 has its own header (T2205916) and silencer (T2208154). The foam air filter (T2205329) fits every TF. Akrapovic systems from Triumph are listed separately for the 2024-2025 TF 250-X (A9601343) and the 2026 TF 250-X (A9601349/A9601360), and for the TF 450 (A9601344/A9601361).
